data.one_liner: Riverpod_lint is a static analysis plugin that flags common Riverpod mistakes and offers quick refactorings.
data.what_it_does: It runs as an analysis_server_plugin, providing lint rules and assists for Riverpod code. It warns about missing ProviderScope, improper family usage, and offers refactorings to ConsumerWidget variants.
use_when: You use Riverpod and want to catch common mistakes early
You need automated refactorings for ProviderScope or ConsumerWidget patterns
avoid_when: You prefer to write custom lints or use a different linting framework
strengths: Zero runtime cost, integrates with dart analyze
Keeps codebase consistent with Riverpod best practices
weaknesses: Only works with Riverpod, not other state managers
Requires Dart 3.13 due to analysis_server_plugin dependency
data.setup_notes: Add riverpod_lint to analysis_options.yaml under plugins, no build_runner needed
